cases.input: Two studies apply one approved method revision with different populations and parameters.
cases.expect: The method is shared while executions, inputs, findings and limitations remain study-owned.

cases.input: One study yields productivity-decline and routing-change interpretations.
cases.expect: Both findings coexist as conflict-linked claims with their own evidence and confidence.

cases.input: A recommendation is later accepted by an authorized decision.
cases.expect: The recommendation remains resolvable while decision content and occurrence record acceptance and effect.

cases.input: Ticket growth is claimed to cause productivity decline without a measurand or comparator.
cases.expect: The causal claim is rejected or bounded as low-confidence association.

cases.input: Study parameters and outputs overwrite the reusable method definition.
A report issue is treated as conclusion justification.
cases.expect: The substitution is rejected; evidence bindings remain required.

cases.input: Publishing a recommendation automatically changes policy.
cases.expect: The effect is rejected without decision content and authorized occurrence.
